<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Lantern rounds</title></head><body>
<tw-storydata name="Lantern rounds" startnode="1" format="SugarCube" format-version="2.37.3" ifid="aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa">
<tw-passagedata pid="9" name="StoryInit" tags=""><<set $rounds to 0>></tw-passagedata>
<tw-passagedata pid="1" name="Start" tags="">Night watch begins.
[[Oil the lamp|OilLamp]]
[[Trim the wick|TrimWick]]</tw-passagedata>
<tw-passagedata pid="2" name="OilLamp" tags=""><<set $lampReady to "oiled">>
[[Climb to the lantern|LanternRoom]]</tw-passagedata>
<tw-passagedata pid="3" name="TrimWick" tags=""><<set $lampReady to "trimmed">>
[[Climb to the lantern|LanternRoom]]</tw-passagedata>
<tw-passagedata pid="4" name="LanternRoom" tags=""><<if $lampReady is "oiled">>The flame burns steady.<<else>>The flame burns bright.<</if>>
<<set $rounds to $rounds + 1>>
<<if $rounds lt 2>>[[Begin another round|Start]]<<else>>Dawn at last.<</if>></tw-passagedata>
</tw-storydata></body></html>
